# ataila_release_operation (Data Source)

One release operation: a promotion, or a data copy booked in the portal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_release_operation" "last" {
  id = ataila_release_promotion.api_prod.id
}

output "prod_request_status" {
  value = data.ataila_release_operation.last.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The release operation's id.

### Read-Only

- `approval_reason` (String) The reason and the approver's note; addresses and digests masked.
- `completed_at` (String) When it ended. RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `component` (String) `app-api` or `www`; null for a data copy.
- `decided_at` (String) When it was decided. RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `decided_by` (String) Who approved or rejected it.
- `error_reason` (String) Why it failed or was rejected; addresses and digests masked.
- `operation` (String) `promote_build` or `copy_data`.
- `operation_id` (String) `release:<id>`.
- `pipeline_url` (String) The pipeline carrying it out, once known.
- `portal_status` (String) The Release Manager's own status.
- `project_id` (String) The project.
- `requested_at` (String) When it was requested. RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `requested_by` (String) Who asked.
- `requested_token_id` (String) The API token used, when one was.
- `requested_via` (String) `session`, `pat` or `service_account`; null when booked in the portal or by a pipeline.
- `source_env` (String) The environment it comes from.
- `started_at` (String) When it started. RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `status` (String) `awaiting_approval`, `pending`, `running`, `succeeded` or `failed`.
- `target_env` (String) The environment it goes to.
- `version` (String) The version promoted.
